title: Coset geometries acting on their elements: The $j$-diagonals twisting
summary: Let $β$ be a coset incidence system and fix a type $j$. We use the orbits of the group of $β$ on pairs of distinct $j$-elements to define a Coxeter graph. The action on the $j$-elements induces an action on the corresponding Coxeter group, so the twisting construction for coset incidence systems can be applied. The resulting coset geometry, called the $j$-diagonals twisting, is always a regular hypertope if $β$ is a regular hypertope.
